subject: Television & Streaming
title: Squid Game and Global Inequality
description: A short lesson to help you apply Squid Game and Global Inequality.

hook.text: In 2021, a Korean show about desperate people playing deadly children's games became Netflix's most-watched series ever.

buildup.text: Squid Game depicted debt-crushed adults competing for money. The games were childish. The consequences were fatal.

discovery.text: The show resonated globally because economic inequality is universal.

twist.text: Squid Game proved that non-English content could dominate global streaming.

climax.text: A Korean show about poverty became a global phenomenon because the story of inequality needs no translation.

punchline.text: The world watched a Korean parable and saw their own lives.

quiz.question: Why did Squid Game resonate with audiences worldwide?
options: Economic inequality is a universal experience that transcended language
